display_name: Theopiste, daughter of Theodora of Thessalonica

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 3 Αυγούστου, «Οσίες Θεοδώρα εξ Αιγίνης και Θεοπίστη η θυγατέρα της», with the rank word and the kinship clause left off. Her own head line on the life page is «Οσια Θεοπιστη Θυγατερα Της Οσιας Θεοδωρας Εξ Αιγινης».

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 3ης Αυγούστου — «Οσίες Θεοδώρα εξ Αιγίνης και Θεοπίστη η θυγατέρα της»

attestations.note: Two days, and the page states the relation between them itself: the listing that names her is the 3 Αυγούστου one and her life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», but the page's own closing sentence is «Οι Οσίες εορτάζονται την 29η Αυγούστου, αλλά η γιορτή τους μεταφέρθηκε την 3η Αυγούστου λόγω της γιορτής της απότομης της Τιμίας Κεφαλής του Αγίου Ιωάννου Προδρόμου.» — the two are commemorated on 29 August, but their feast was transferred to 3 August because of the Beheading. 29 August is therefore recorded as the feast and 3 August is the day the line was read on; one attestation row per church is the schema, so the second day is this note and not a second row. Her mother's folder, theodora-of-thessalonica, already carries a venerated greek row on 29 August sourced from the 29 Αυγούστου day listing, which names the mother alone; that row was not touched. saint.gr gives the mother's repose as 892 and gives the daughter no year, no place of her own and no rank beyond Οσία, so there is no `dates` object and no `locations` entry. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page. The page prints one distich, which names Theodora alone, and no apolytikion and no kontakion, so no hymn is taken.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
